description: Conversion of existing attached garage into a habitable room and installation of new roof to existing detached garage and conversion to a gym
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered proposed block plan 1:500, Unnumbered location plan 1:1250, Unnumbered block plan 1:500, 41RIDGEWAYROAD 01, 41RIDGEWAYROAD 02, 41RIDGEWAYROAD 03. Received: 9th September 2019. 
41RIDGEWAYROAD Rev104. Received: 18th October 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the alterations to two existing garages hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of existing garages and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The existing garages shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 41 Ridgeway Road, TW7 5LE.
